title: Helical Wind Turbine
subtitle: Two blocks tall, best up high
text:
The turbine needs a free block above where you place it. Breaking either half takes the whole turbine.

Output is up to 50 FE/t: 50 x height x open air x weather. Height counts from Y 64 (nothing) to Y 160 (full). Open air is the share of air in the 9x9x9 space around the rotor, checked every 5 seconds. Rain gives x1.25 and thunder x1.5.

It stores 20k FE and gives LV out of the base. Right click it to read it.
